column1: # copyCalibrationToRam() copies ROM 0x3C30-0x7F60 (17KB) to RAM 0x3F9800-0x3FDB30 at boot.
# These ~50 functions execute from RAM for MPC555 performance (RAM faster than flash).
# mainLoopIteration calls two of these RAM functions directly via bl:
#   bl 0x3FC094 -> processJ1939QueueStatus   (ROM 0x64C4) - J1939 TP queue manager
# Both use identical 40-phase cooperative scheduler. Task groups map by position:
# See docs/cross-firmware-analysis.md for complete mapping table.
# RAM copy: ROM 0x526C -> RAM 0x3FAE3C (called from mainLoopIteration via bl)
# RAM copy: ROM 0x62FC -> RAM 0x3FBECC (called from processJ1939QueueStatus)
# RAM copy: ROM 0x6490 -> RAM 0x3FC060 (called from processJ1939QueueStatus)
# RAM copy: ROM 0x64C4 -> RAM 0x3FC094 (called from mainLoopIteration via bl)
